g.text: Blank-corrected reporter RFU slope relative to WT (fold)
Each point is one mutant measured in one screening well; AF3 scores are means over five model samples.
The dashed horizontal line marks >1.5-fold screening signals. Fold is a blank-corrected reporter RFU slope ratio,
not kcat or a validated hit. Colors use both score thresholds; a point may fail the threshold shown in the other panel.
Source: Chen et al., Computational design of metalloproteases, bioRxiv v3 (2026-09-21); Zenodo 22654831.
Retrospective reanalysis of 378 Zn45 single-substitution records; no prospective validation or cross-scaffold claim.
